Logical relationships are maintained throughout, with explanations for changes provided (e.g., S6 explains net profit decline, S17 explains EBITDA growth). The organization is clear, progressing from overall performance to segment details and financial resilience. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity. All figures and their contexts are presented in a way that forms a coherent narrative without internal inconsistencies.
